config.title: Jev Security Linter
config.model.description: Decision AI model to use (OpenRouter model slug)
config.searchStrategy.description: Vulnerability search algorithm (binarySearch: divide & conquer down to minimumBlockSize, slidingWindow: fixed-size window scan)
config.minimumBlockSize.description: Minimum block size (lines) to stop binary search division (pinpoint line granularity)
config.overlapRatio.description: Boundary overlap ratio for binary search (0.0 - 0.4). Overlap lines = floor(lines * ratio)
config.maxChunkChars.description: Maximum character length per model request. Larger blocks are divided locally without API calls to stay within context limits.
config.windowLines.description: Number of lines per scan window (used when searchStrategy is slidingWindow)
config.overlapLines.description: Overlap lines between consecutive windows (used when searchStrategy is slidingWindow)
config.supportedLanguages.description: List of language IDs to automatically scan
